name: Caos Idílico
source:
A nameless heroine wakes in a dark forest with no idea who she is. Caos Idílico follows her as she meets odd beings, hears strange languages, and pieces together her past.

[From [url=https://purple-grannygc.itch.io/caos-idlico]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位无名的女主角在黑暗的森林中醒来，不知道自己是谁。卡奥斯·伊迪利科（Caos Idílico）跟随她，遇见了奇怪的生物，听到了奇怪的语言，并拼凑了她的过去。

[来自[url=https://purple-grannygc.itch.io/caos-idlico]Itch.io[/url]]
